decisions.reason: Identifies node.exe PID 42432, the dsh web host that loaded koffi at startup, as the holder; explains the loaded native image stays in use for the process lifetime so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY.
Explains refresh reloads only the SPA client while the host keeps the lock; gives ordered stop → verify PID gone → install → verify version → restart in separate numbered commands.
Unversioned install follows latest (0.1.1-rc.2) not alpha (0.1.2-alpha.5); global install replaces rather than preserves/upgrades alpha.4 — silent downgrade.

Gives pinned npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the TUI install after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, restarts; @alpha discussed only as a floating alternative.

Tells README authors to pin the exact tested core version in any command that also installs dsh, warn that unpinned follows latest over an existing prerelease, and publish a stop→install→verify→restart template.
